runtime.transport: FastAPI TestClient with local SQLite state; no external requests

before_change: The terminal workflow was preserved, but adoption returned only the generic parked-workflow error.
after_change: The API returns HTTP 409 with an explicit terminal-workflow unsupported message and directs the owner to start a new run from the saved workflow.
decision: Terminal-run amendment adoption is unsupported. This avoids presenting a terminal result as amendable when current reuse rules cannot safely transfer effect receipts across revisions; start a fresh saved-workflow run instead.
